# Song of Solomon Chapter 2 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 2 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 2:1 — "rose" vs. "wildflower"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-rose [chavatzelet] of-Sharon" | Traditional with transliteration |
| LOGOS | "a rose of Sharon" | Traditional English |
| PNEUMA | "a wildflower of the plain" | Botanically accurate |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "rose of Sharon" — too iconic to change.

---

## 2:12 — "singing" vs. "pruning"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-time of-singing" | *zamir* = singing |
| LOGOS | "the time of singing" | Birdsong context |
| PNEUMA | "the season of singing birds" | Explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the season of singing."

**Status:** All resolved.
